48@fragment
49fn fragmentMain(@location(0) uv: vec2<f32>) -> @location(0) vec4<f32> {
50 // Use current canvas resolution supplied via uniform
51 let width = u32(screen.width);
52 let height = u32(screen.height);
53
54 let x = u32(uv.x * f32(width));
55 let y = u32(uv.y * f32(height));
56
57 if (x >= width || y >= height) {
58 return vec4<f32>(0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 1.0);
59 }
60
61 let index = y * width + x;
62 let rgba = rayTraceOutput[index];
63
64 // Unpack RGBA8
65 let r = f32((rgba >> 0u) & 0xFFu) / 255.0;
66 let g = f32((rgba >> 8u) & 0xFFu) / 255.0;
67 let b = f32((rgba >> 16u) & 0xFFu) / 255.0;
68 let a = f32((rgba >> 24u) & 0xFFu) / 255.0;
69
70 // Composite over black opaque background
71 let backgroundColor = vec3<f32>(0.0, 0.0, 0.0);
72 let volumeColor = vec3<f32>(r, g, b);
73 let composited = volumeColor * a + backgroundColor * (1.0 - a);
74
75 return vec4<f32>(composited, 1.0); // Always output opaque
76}
